code:
1. Vest reward claims
   -> linear unlock over weeks/months, not instant

2. Taper emissions on a schedule
   -> high at bootstrap, decreasing over time

3. Add a real-yield component
   -> route a share of actual trading fees to farmers
      so some APY survives even if the reward token -> $0
caption: Three levers that turn mercenary capital into sticky liquidity.
